items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section I, List of Answers on Terminology 21:1
items.html: “Singular” indicates the upper light, which shines and governs throughout the whole multiplicity of degrees that differ from one another, to the point of reversing them and equalising them to His singular form. “Unique” indicates the completion of that governance, that is, after He has already equalised them and returned their form to the discernment of singular like His own. See Item 10. (Part 1, Inner Observation, Item 1)
